name: com.tencent.timpush.honor.MyHonorMessageService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Honor messaging adapter receives Honor push events. It sends refreshed Honor registration tokens to Tencent Cloud IM; incoming-message callbacks are only recorded by this adapter.
disableEffect: Tencent Cloud IM stops receiving Honor token updates through this service, so Honor offline-push registration stops refreshing.
